column1: # corpora.tsv — the registry of every external corpus and oracle payload
# excise can download. TRACKED IN GIT; the data it points at is NOT.
#   name      stable id, used as `scripts/corpus.sh fetch <name>`
#   tier      core     — fetch these to run the local suite as CI would
#             extended — larger or narrower; fetch when you need them
#             planned  — recommended, no download script yet; see the issue
#   dir       destination, relative to the repo root (must be gitignored)
#   script    scripts/<script> that fetches it, or an issue ref when planned
#   size      approximate on-disk size once fetched
#   licence   of the corpus itself, for the licence policy
#   purpose   what it is FOR — why a redaction/rendering defect would show up
# Adding a row is how a corpus becomes visible to `corpus.sh` and to
# check-corpus-registry.sh, which fails if a row's dir is not gitignored.
